narrative.summary: BioGraph Steward connects scoped questions to Pharos-based evidence graphs, cited answers and auditable exports. The core workflow now includes reproducible biological assessment; independent predictive benefit and user validation remain in progress.
accomplishments: Built a guided Pharos/CIViC workbench with source inspection, review of proposed changes and exports preserving the full graph, original evidence and edge decisions.
Integrated IntAct/IMEx records with the official JAMI reader and PSI-MI vocabulary. Development checks preserve identities, assay methods and references; richer XML audits retain experiment context.

Connected NVIDIA Nemotron through vLLM for optional construction planning, with explicit scope checks and user review. Deterministic execution supports the current workflow while broader agent reliability remains under development.

Completed reproducible PyKEEN R-GCN assessment against 1,751 experimentally tested protein pairs. Adding Reactome memberships gave a small mean average precision increase (0.7178 to 0.7196), with mixed seed effects.

Published qualified assay observations, including nondetections. Assisted user feedback improved export guidance. MIT-licensed code passes isolated build, installation and offline replay checks; Docker/Brev configuration is available.
blockers: Consistent predictive gain remains unproven. The assay panel was reused for development, Pharos postdates the assays, and source overlap remains uncertain.
We have fixed evaluation rules, preserved source context and completed coverage checks. Next are study-level overlap verification and an independent user walkthrough when a colleague is available.
Clarification of the organizer baseline, scoring and submission format will guide final packaging. Brev compute and AWS credits are available; infrastructure access is not currently a blocker.
milestones: Complete study-level provenance checks and qualify an independent reference; retain the fixed Reactome result and incorporate organizer scoring requirements when clarified.
Assess preservation of curated evidence under frozen rules and documented overlap exclusions; run an independent colleague walkthrough when available.
Release a reproducible demonstration with manifests and evaluation results; verify real-data replay and deploy on AWS if the demonstration requires it.
